sourceText: User (2026-07-09, during B-2861 document review): token consumption across host accounts is the highest-priority problem. Open a separate high-priority story to stop token exhaustion before the larger document rollout completes. Only change scope-plan / behavior prompt search strategy, necessary prompt mirrors, and static tests; do not change lifecycle gates / DONE gates / memory gate-evidence semantics.
normalizedOutcome: Default scope-plan and behavior reviewer runs stop reading the full docs/requirements/decisions corpus (111 files, ~2.4MB); they use bounded memory/playbook preflight plus a candidateSpecSet (<=15 full reads) and only full-scan with a recorded scanEscalationReason, with mirrors synced and a static guard preventing regression.
acceptanceClaim: All six active prompt copies contain the bounded preflight + candidateSpecSet + scanEscalationReason wording with no unconditional full-scan instruction, and the reviewer-scan-budget guard smoke passes while a temporary reintroduction of the old wording makes it fail.
